segments.an4.80:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
segments.an4.80:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an4.80:2.1: “Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena mātugāmo neva sabhāyaṃ nisīdati, na kammantaṃ payojeti, na kambojaṃ gacchatī”ti?
segments.an4.80:2.5: duppañño, ānanda, mātugāmo – ayaṃ kho, ānanda, hetu ayaṃ paccayo, yena mātugāmo neva sabhāyaṃ nisīdati, na kammantaṃ payojeti, na kambojaṃ gacchatī”ti.
segments.an4.80:3.1: Padhānaṃ diṭṭhisappurisa, vadhukā dve ca honti aggāni;

lines: Dasame neva sabhāyaṃ nisīdatīti vinicchayakaraṇatthaṃ vinicchayasabhāyaṃ neva nisīdati.
Na kambojaṃ gacchatīti bhoge sambharaṇatthāya kambojaraṭṭhaṃ na gacchati.
Desanāmattameva cetaṃ, yaṃ kiñci tiroraṭṭhaṃ na gacchatīti attho.
Kodhanotiādīsu kodhanatāya kodhapariyuṭṭhito atthānatthaṃ na jānāti, issukitāya parasampattiṃ na sahati, maccharitāya dhanaṃ datvā kiccaṃ kātuṃ na sakkoti, nippaññatāya kiccaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ na sakkoti.
